limitations: Retrospective sampled months are not prospective certification or a complete contiguous multi-year portfolio.
Fixed 1R outcome accounting, not compounded account sizing, margin, cross-asset correlation or drawdown locks.
No parameter retuning after validation or holdout; controls are never eligible for selection.
Hourly fills resolved with actual 15m OHLC; same-bar protection ambiguities conservatively stop first.
Funding is an explicit reserve, not reconstructed realized funding history. Estimated execution costs need provider validation.
5m MicroScalper higher-timeframe wiring is tested separately, not performance-certified by this 15m/1h study.
Forex strategies need real MT5 broker history; no Forex performance inferred from crypto.
implementationNotes: The predeclared protocol prose says 200 warmup bars. Before development began the implementation used 110 closed bars to match the production window; the original protocol and hash are retained transparently. No selection thresholds or time splits changed after evaluation.
